Operators who set CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET for any other purpose (it is a generically-named webhook secret) silently activate credential sync, redirecting all OAuth refreshes to CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT when set — behavior cannot be toggled independently of the secret and leaks the secret's value into any place the 'boolean' is serialized.
